summary: Frontend regression + new feature testing for Badger Fantasy Association SvelteKit app after lib refactor. Tested all 14 routes/scenarios via preview URL. All regression pages (home, standings, matchups w22 + w1 overrides, honor-hall, rosters, records-team, records-player, power-rankings, team/zamt, admin/generate-season-matchups) load correctly with zero console errors. Both NEW pages (/rules and /admin/player-id-lookup) work as specified. Navigation and footer links validated.

NEW_player_id_lookup.copy-pid-button_toggles_to_checkmark: verified with clipboard permission granted (✓ shown). Without permission falls back to window.prompt which is expected behavior.

critical_code_review_comments: Code refactor looks clean - barrel exports ($lib/api, $lib/compute) work without breaking any existing route.
Player ID Lookup uses navigator.clipboard.writeText with a window.prompt fallback - good defensive coding.
Rules page successfully pulls live scoring values from Sleeper API (verified Block=+2, Steal=+2, 3PM=+0.5, Triple-Double=+3, etc.).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a fully client-side SvelteKit static site on preview URL. No backend. Pages need 3-5s to settle after fetching Sleeper API. The matchups page uses custom styled dropdowns (not native <select>) for season/week selectors. Player ID Lookup's copy button requires clipboard permission to visually toggle to ✓; grant via page.context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']) in headless testing.
